name: The Ottoman Empire
description: The Ottoman Empire from Osman's small state in 1299 to its end in 1922: the sultans, conquests, buildings and fall.

checkpoints.name: Rise
checkpoints.note: Osman founds a small state in Anatolia. His heirs cross into Europe and surround Constantinople.

checkpoints.name: The great age
checkpoints.note: Mehmed II takes Constantinople. Selim and Suleiman conquer from Hungary to Arabia, and Sinan builds the great mosques of Istanbul.

checkpoints.name: Decline and reform
checkpoints.note: After the defeat at Vienna the empire loses land. The Tanzimat and the Young Turks try to modernise it.

checkpoints.name: The end
checkpoints.note: The empire joins the First World War, wins at Gallipoli, commits the Armenian genocide and loses most of its lands. In 1922 the sultanate is abolished.
